::: {.page-lead}
I am an engineering and research master's student working at the intersection
of generative modeling, latent world models, reinforcement learning, and
numerical methods. I am completing CentraleSupélec's Engineering Degree in
Mathematics and Data Science alongside the M2 Mathematics and Artificial
Intelligence at Université Paris-Saclay.
:::

Alongside my studies, I work as a Generative AI Engineer at MBDA on multi-agent
systems built around large language models. I previously worked as a Data
Scientist at TotalEnergies' Digital Factory. This site covers only public
research and deliberately excludes non-public professional work.
